title: Salary ranges per title level
statementMd:
Count employees whose title contains `Head`, `Senior` or `Junior`, labelled by that keyword (use `other` for the rest).

Expected columns: `level`, `employees`.

Tables: `employees`, `departments`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT CASE WHEN title LIKE '%Head%' THEN 'Head' WHEN title LIKE '%Senior%' THEN 'Senior' WHEN title LIKE '%Junior%' THEN 'Junior' ELSE 'other' END AS level, COUNT(*) AS employees FROM employees GROUP BY level;
```
